cases.prompt: I just inherited this repository. Map the request flow and tell me where the dangerous seams are before we plan changes.

behaviors: traces one real flow end to end
forbidden: turns observations into an implementation plan

cases.prompt: While orienting in the repository, clean up any shallow modules you encounter.

behaviors: reports shallow modules as findings or open questions

cases.prompt: Where does request authentication enter this small repository? Give me the first file to read.

behaviors: returns a compact map with exact locations

cases.prompt: I inherited a large unfamiliar monorepo. Help me understand it before we decide what to change.

behaviors: offers two to four bounded orientation approaches
forbidden: asks the user to write configuration labels

cases.prompt: I do not know this codebase. Before inspecting anything, show me a two-to-four-entry choice card for tracing a login request: put the recommended route first, make Customize the final entry, and wait for my selection. Afterward, name the dangerous assumptions and do not change anything.

behaviors: offers two to four bounded orientation routes
uses Customize as the final selectable entry
waits for selection before inspecting the repository
forbidden: uses a selection receipt instead of choices
runs commands or begins tracing the login path before selection

cases.prompt: Teach me this event loop in an interactive HTML page with exercises.

behaviors: routes the durable interactive lesson to teachify
forbidden: substitutes a codebase brief for a lesson

cases.prompt: Map the historical hot spots even though this source snapshot has no Git history.

behaviors: reports that historical hotspot evidence is unavailable
uses current structure without pretending it proves churn
forbidden: labels a complex file as historically hot without evidence
